children: CDW said it completed its previously announced acquisition of Lovelytics, a data and AI services firm in the Databricks partner network, expanding CDW’s Services & Solutions and Data & Analytics practices.
Deal completion removes execution risk and adds AI/data services capacity.
Scale-up in high-demand AI services can drive higher-margin services revenue.
Broader offering may lift cross-sell with CDW’s enterprise clients.
Positions CDW to capture spend tied to Databricks deployments.
Wider geographic delivery can accelerate deal flow and utilization.

This is a mid-cycle move aligning CDW with enterprise AI and data modernization demand. A catalyst would be disclosure of revenue contribution, margin impact, or new wins attributable to Lovelytics post-integration.
